import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares

N = 150_000
COUNTS = (1, 6, N - 7)
TARGET = 10.0
TOL = 0.001


def residual(x):
    a, c, b = np.exp(x)
    n_a, n_c, n_b = COUNTS
    return np.array([
        (n_a * a + n_c * c + n_b * b) / N - 1.0,
        (n_a * a * np.log(a) + n_c * c * np.log(c) + n_b * b * np.log(b)) / N - TARGET,
        -(n_a * np.log(a) + n_c * np.log(c) + n_b * np.log(b)) / N - TARGET,
    ])


starts = ([10.0, 10.0, -10.0], [9.0, 9.8, -10.0], [11.0, 9.7, -10.0])
fit = None
for start in starts:
    candidate = least_squares(
        residual, start, xtol=1e-15, ftol=1e-15, gtol=1e-15, max_nfev=10000
    )
    if np.max(np.abs(candidate.fun)) < 1e-10:
        fit = candidate
        break

if fit is None:
    raise RuntimeError("Failed to find a valid two-scale distribution")

a, c, b = np.exp(fit.x)
q = np.empty(N, dtype=np.float64)
q[0] = a
q[1:7] = c
q[7:] = b
p = q / q.sum()

u = np.full(N, 1.0 / N)
forward_kl = np.sum(p * np.log(p / u))
backward_kl = np.sum(u * np.log(u / p))

assert abs(p.sum() - 1.0) < 1e-12
assert np.all(p > 0.0)
assert abs(forward_kl - TARGET) <= TOL
assert abs(backward_kl - TARGET) <= TOL

np.save("/app/dist.npy", p)
print(f"forward KL:  {forward_kl:.12f}")
print(f"backward KL: {backward_kl:.12f}")
print(f"saved {p.shape[0]} probabilities to /app/dist.npy")
